active.description: A twelve-week block that opens with a four-week Strength Reentry on-ramp, then eight weeks of foundation training balancing heavy lifting, rowing intervals, Zone 2 aerobic work, and athletic variety for long-term health and body composition.
active.name: Athletic Health Foundation

others.description: An eight-week evolution of the Foundation Block: the same heavy lifting, rowing intervals, and Zone 2 aerobic volume, redistributed across the week, with Friday's athletic day traded for upper-body hypertrophy.
others.name: Athletic Hypertrophy

others.description: A sustainable, open-ended block balancing full-body strength, intervals, and aerobic work with moderate progression and readiness-based volume, built for consistency over peak performance.
others.name: Fat Loss Maintenance

others.description: An eight-week rowing block targeting 2k, 5k, and 10k performance with VO₂, threshold, and long aerobic rows, while maintaining strength at a reduced volume.
others.name: Rowing Performance

others.description: A six-week strength and power block built on heavy compound lifts, low-rep primary prescriptions, hill sprints, and explosive work, with minimal rowing volume.
others.name: Strength & Power
